text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Approaching the 4th corner! This is where 
the real battle begins!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Time for the finishing touch.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey takes the lead!! She pulls 
ahead!! Dream Journey!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey crosses the finish line in 
first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —What a fine view.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey did it! She made size 
difference look totally irrelevant— she 
was so freakin' cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was the abso-lute best~!! Wow, I'm 
definitely stanning her forever now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —For that glory, my heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Journey-san.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I have indeed witnessed it, Dear Sister—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we immerse ourselves for a while?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To our 'journey'— and to this blessing we 
seized along the way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dream Journey and I listened to 
the cheers celebrating her victory for a 
brief moment—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, during the winner's interview—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us straight up— what was 
the single biggest factor behind this 
victory?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...It is remarkably difficult to narrow 
it down to just one, but if I were to 
choose—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I believe the greatest factor in my 
victory was the assistance of everyone in 
the Mejiro family, who showed me how to 
fight in long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
What...!? You had the support of the 
Mejiro family!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Through a certain connection, we got 
in touch—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"These words from Dream Journey sparked a 
buzz not only among the spectators 
present, but widely throughout racing fans 
as well—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey had the Mejiro family 
backing her up? Seriously...! Talk about 
an unexpected connection~.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen a Mejiro Umamusume around 
lately... but man, they really are still 
strong over long distances...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It served as a reminder to the world of 
the Mejiro family's true power...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey and I were having a meeting 
to confirm the destination of our next 
"journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Taking this opportunity, I decided to 
verify one thing with her—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...All in all, I'd say things are going 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—The greatest takeaway so far has 
definitely been facing Vodka-san, the 
'tempest,' at the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her running, which completely tears down 
the walls between different racing routes, 
is bound to take the world by storm from 
now on...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To have run in a race that served as such 
a turning point for her was the greatest 
stroke of luck.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for the "ray of gold" supposed to be at 
the end of the "journey"... I still 
haven't even caught a glimpse of its 
outline.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well... naturally.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
After all, we have only confronted the 
"storm" once so far.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case... you know what that means, 
right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Where we ought to set our sights on next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The answers were limited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A "storm" always brews at the forefront of 
the era, at the cutting edge of the racing 
world. If so, then our next destination is 
inevitably—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai to determine the strongest 
in spring medium-distance. The Tenno Sho 
(Spring), the longest race at 3,200m. The 
fan-voted Grand Prix, the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The collective name for these three GⅠ 
races. That is the "Spring Senior Triple 
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is an intensely demanding rotation, 
running it all within a short span of 
about four months, yet the starting gate 
attracts the finest Umamusume of the era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to encounter many "storms," 
there could be no stage more fitting than 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having forged bonds with the Mejiro 
family, overcome her own limits, and 
conquered long-distance GⅠ races, she can 
surely endure this grueling rotation now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And I believe she can summon the 'storm' 
she desires, and reach the 'streak of 
gold'—!”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I find that very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead, and the harsh trials 
waiting in store.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That you will stand and face them 
together with me."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. Toward spring, in pursuit of an 
even greater 'storm.'
choice_data_list: Ah, right! First up is the Osaka Hai!
Ah, right! First up is the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As a Trainer, nothing could make me 
happier than this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That emotion gently welled up and spread 
through my chest—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Spring Senior Triple Crown"—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Among those, Ane-go ran the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) and Takarazuka Kinen multiple 
times, facing countless "storms" there.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(And every time that happened, Big Sis... 
always looked so happy—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haha...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a predicament. Truly a dilemma—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving in to overflowing emotion, the 
traveler yearns for spring, a crescent 
smile curving across her lips—
